name: Dottler
description: Dottler, the Radome Pokémon, and the evolved form of Blipbug. Able to evolve into Orbeetle. A Bug and Psychic type.
pokedex_entries: It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.
As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.
